description: Comprehensive project discovery, task selection, and implementation planning with bulletproof error handling

context.task_description: Execute comprehensive task analysis and selection using bulletproof project discovery with all defensive programming principles from /pr:task logic
requirements: DEFENSIVE: Validate all input parameters before proceeding - check formats, existence, and completeness
DISCOVERY: Execute multi-pattern project detection with comprehensive fallback algorithms
SELECTION: Apply task selection algorithms with priority formulas and systematic decision trees
ANALYSIS: Perform pattern discovery and complexity assessment with confidence scoring
PLANNING: Generate comprehensive implementation context for execution phase
VALIDATION: Verify all analysis results meet quality thresholds before handoff creation
constraints: Must handle all input modes: project_only, task_id, description, continue
Must work across all project types: Templum, Haruspex, phoenix-code-lite, repo-agnostic
Must preserve existing task selection logic and priority formulas exactly
Must provide fallback strategies for all potential failure scenarios
Must include confidence scoring and escalation protocols

input_validation: Validate input_type matches expected values: project_only|task_id|description|continue
Check project name format and validate against known project structures
Verify task_id format matches TASK-ID pattern if provided
Validate description length and content if provided
Check continue_context structure and completeness if provided
project_discovery: Execute primary project detection using standard directory structures
Implement fallback search patterns for non-standard project layouts
Validate project structure integrity before proceeding
Check file permissions for all required project files
Provide clear error messages when project detection fails
file_operations: Always check file existence before attempting to read
Verify directory permissions before file access
Use absolute paths in all file operations and handoff data
Implement timeout handling for file operations
Validate file content format before parsing

repo_agnostic_detection: Search for active-tasks files in known locations
Validate repo-level pattern files and documentation
fallback_strategies: Search for project indicators in directory names
Look for package.json or similar configuration files
Use filename patterns to infer project structure
error_handling: Provide specific error messages for each failure mode
Include suggested recovery actions for common issues
List all search locations attempted for debugging
Escalate to manual intervention with complete context

task_selection_algorithm.priority_formula: Quick Priority = Impact + Feasibility + Blocking (each 1-5, total 3-15)
selection_hierarchy: 1. [TASK-ID] provided: Direct task selection with validation
5. [ ] Pending Tasks: Priority-based selection with scoring
edge_case_handling: No available tasks: Check investigation queue and roadmap
Multiple equal-priority: Apply secondary criteria and dependency analysis
Invalid task-id: Provide similar task suggestions and format examples
Malformed task data: Attempt recovery and provide clear error context

discovery_process: Locate pattern files using systematic search patterns
Parse pattern content and extract usage information
Match task requirements against available patterns
confidence_scoring: Pattern relevance: 0-100 based on keyword and context matching
Implementation feasibility: 0-100 based on complexity and dependencies
Success probability: 0-100 based on pattern maturity and usage history
Overall confidence: Weighted average with quality thresholds

confidence_thresholds: Medium confidence: 70-85% - Proceed with warnings and monitoring
Low confidence: <70% - Escalate to manual review before proceeding
complexity_assessment: Simple tasks (≤10 complexity): Direct implementation approach
Complex tasks (>10 complexity): Systematic analysis and planning required
Critical tasks: Additional validation and review checkpoints
simplicity_checks: Is this really architectural complexity or just refactoring?
Can the simplest solution work without over-engineering?
Are we treating method changes as system design issues?
Does this require >30 minutes to understand or >5 file changes?

success_criteria: Exactly one task selected with complete implementation context
All project files located and validated for accessibility
Pattern analysis completed with confidence scoring >70%
Implementation approach determined with complexity assessment
Comprehensive handoff data prepared for execution phase
All quality thresholds met and validation checkpoints passed
failure_handling: Project detection failure: Provide search results and manual discovery options
Task selection failure: List available tasks and selection criteria
Pattern analysis failure: Proceed with generic approach and flag for manual review
Low confidence results: Escalate to manual intervention with analysis context
File access issues: Provide specific error details and recovery suggestions

phase_1_validation: Validate all input parameters against expected formats
Check parameter completeness and logical consistency
Provide clear error messages with examples for invalid inputs
Confirm workflow variant can be determined from inputs
phase_2_discovery: Execute systematic project discovery with multiple search patterns
Validate project structure and required file accessibility
Load project context and verify file format integrity
Confirm project compatibility with requested operations
phase_3_selection: Apply appropriate task selection method based on inputs
Execute priority algorithms and systematic scoring
Handle edge cases and provide fallback selection options
Validate selected task exists and is actionable
phase_4_analysis: Discover relevant patterns using systematic search algorithms
Assess pattern applicability and implementation requirements
Evaluate complexity and determine implementation approach
Generate confidence scoring and quality assessments
phase_5_planning: Prepare comprehensive execution context for implementation
Structure handoff data with all required information
Apply escalation protocols and validation checkpoints
Confirm analysis completeness and handoff creation
